site.heroTitle: Trace Japanese distance running lineages through Hakone Ekiden athletes.
site.heroDescription: Starting with athlete rosters from Aoyama Gakuin University, Kokugakuin University, and Chuo University, this archive organizes origins, affiliations, key records, and Hakone appearances.
site.footer: We are building a people-centered archive with clear data sources and verification status.
